name: Nonomiya Mia
source:
Misaki’s class mate.

She doesn’t show much affection and keeps a cool front.

Her dignified expression gives a lasting impression.

She is pure at heart but her detached way of speaking brings her many misunderstandings.
She is doted as a cat by her close friends. In fact, she is cat like.

When it comes to playing the piano, she has a talent that even surprises Misaki. She is well talked in the school since the time of her enrolling.

She holds high ambition towards music that’s why she won’t uphold no compromise when it comes to training for the quartet.
